$comment: Alert thresholds for scripts/ci/merge-queue-snapshot.mjs — tune without code changes

queue_depth.why: Serial queue (max_entries_to_merge=1); depth>3 is sustained backlog

max_age_sec.why: Warn at 30m; critical near 90m ruleset check timeout

median_age_sec.why: Typical green docs PR should clear well under 15–45m once required CI is green

dirty_open_prs.why: Content conflicts never enter the queue — ownership/serialisation smell

behind_open_prs.why: Stale heads need update-branch; not a queue latency problem

blocked_open_prs.why: Required checks/reviews stuck across many PRs

auto_merge_waiting.why: Many auto-merge/queue requests waiting often means required gates never go green
